rules_verified: Structural state is driven only by Macro + Rates/CB.
Improvement/turning is separate from structural state.
Price confirms/diverges but does not decide structural direction.
COT does not decide structural direction.
Liquidity remains an overlay and does not decide structural direction.
Pair Macro and Policy sides are derived from the canonical currency states.
